service.description: The current user's permission on calendars: CalpManage for a calendar whose owner is the user's party, else the highest current CalendarShare for the user, one of the user's groups, the user's party or an organization the user's party belongs to (a PrtAgent, PrtEmployee or PrtMember relationship); a publish link does not count. With calendarId and permissionEnumId, an error when the user has less; a calendar the user has no permission on is "not found". permissionMap has the permission (or null) of each calendar of calendarIdList and calendarId.

parameter.name: permissionEnumId
parameter.description: The permission needed on calendarId: CalpFreeBusy, CalpView, CalpEdit or CalpManage. Empty only reports.

parameter.name: calendar
parameter.description: calendarId's, null when the user has no permission

service.description: The current user's default personal calendar, created on first use (named for the user, kind CalkPersonal, owned by the user's party); when the user has personal calendars but none is the default, the oldest becomes it.

parameter.name: calendarName
parameter.description: For a new calendar; default the user's name

service.description: A personal calendar (the default kind) belongs to the current user's party; the user's first personal calendar is the default one, and isDefault=Y makes this one the default. A shared or resource calendar may belong to an organization (ownerPartyId), and then its creator gets a manage share. A subscription calendar is made by subscribe#Calendar. Without a color the next one of a palette is used.

parameter.name: ownerPartyId
parameter.description: For a shared or resource calendar, the organization (or person) it belongs to; default the user's party

parameter.name: calendarShareId
parameter.description: The creator's manage share of a calendar another party owns

service.description: Needs manage permission. A field left out (null) is not changed. isDefault=Y makes an owned personal calendar the default; the default stays until another calendar is made the default.

Needs manage permission. Removes the calendar with its event rows (the events stay, in their other calendars and for their parties), shares and subscription; the default personal calendar is not deleted (make another the default first). The events of a subscription calendar came from its feed, so those in no other calendar are cancelled with it.

Needs manage permission. Opens the calendar to a user, a user group or a party (a person, or an organization for the users who belong to it) with a permission; when that user, group or party already has a current share, its permission (and thruDate) change instead. With publish=true it makes (or changes) the calendar's publish link instead: anyone with its publishToken may read the calendar, view or free/busy only, with the password when one is set (an empty password removes it; newToken=true makes a new token, so the old link stops working). A calendar an organization owns keeps at least one manage share.

parameter.name: password
parameter.description: A publish link's password; null leaves it as it is

service.description: Needs manage permission. Ends (thruDate now) the current shares named by calendarShareId, userId, userGroupId or partyId, or with publish=true the publish link; the last manage share of a calendar an organization owns is not ended.

The current user's calendars for the calendar rail: group mine (owned by the user's party; the default first), subscription (the user's subscriptions, with the feed's last fetch and status) and shared (shared with the user, the user's groups, party or organizations), each with its color, kind, the user's permission and, for a calendar the user manages, its share count and whether it has a publish link. The default calendar is made first when the user has none (ensureDefault).

The events of a published calendar for anyone with its link (the public route): the publish token (and its password, when it has one) is checked before anything is read, then get#FullCalendarData gives the events of that calendar only, as Busy for a free/busy link.

actions.script: eventList = [] const share = ec.entity.find('mantle.work.calendar.CalendarShare').condition('publishToken', String(publishToken)) .condition(ec.entity.conditionFactory.makeConditionDate('fromDate', 'thruDate', null)).disableAuthz().one() const valid = share != null && !share.userId && !share.userGroupId && !share.partyId && (!share.passwordHash || (password && ec.user.passwordsMatch(String(password), share.passwordHash))) if (!valid) { ec.message.addError('This calendar link is not valid'); return } const calendar = ec.entity.find('mantle.work.calendar.Calendar').condition('calendarId', share.calendarId).disableAuthz().one() calendarName = calendar?.calendarName ?? null color = calendar?.color ?? null eventList = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.EventServices.get#FullCalendarData').parameters({publishToken: publishToken, publishPassword: password, start: start, end: end, titleGString: '${workEffort.workEffortName || "Event"}'}) .disableAuthz().call()?.eventList || []

service.description: Puts an event in a calendar: needs edit permission on the calendar (not a subscription calendar, whose events come from its feed) and that the user may see the event (mantle.work.EventServices.check#EventAccess).
Takes an event out of a calendar (the event stays): needs edit permission on the calendar, not a subscription calendar.

Subscribes the current user to an external calendar: a subscription calendar (kind CalkSubscription, owned by the user's party) with its CalendarSubscription. An iCalendar URL (CspIcsUrl, the default) may be http, https or webcal; Google and Microsoft 365 accounts (CspGoogle, CspMicrosoft) need the OAuth client (later). fetchNow fetches it at once, in the background.

The fetch job: each subscription due (never fetched, or fetched refreshMinutes ago; all with force) is read from its URL and parsed by the framework's ICalendar tool (parse), and its events written into its calendar (store#CalendarFeedEvents), each subscription in a transaction of its own. A subscription that fails gets lastFetchStatus error and the reason in lastFetchError, and the rest go on. Without the tool nothing is fetched (logged once). The job runs with authorization disabled and fetches every subscription due; a user fetches only a subscription of a calendar they own or manage (calendarId, check#CalendarAccess CalpManage).

One subscription of the fetch job: GET its URL (webcal as https) and read what it answered with store#CalendarFeedText. Errors are the caller's to record. With authorization on, only for a calendar the user owns or manages (check#CalendarAccess CalpManage).

A subscription's feed as its URL answered it: parsed by the ICalendar tool (parse), its events written into the subscription's calendar (store#CalendarFeedEvents with replaceAll), and lastFetchDate and lastFetchStatus set (error, with lastFetchError, when some events were not read). fetch#CalendarSubscription calls it with the body of its GET.

parameter.name: feedText
parameter.description: The iCalendar text of the feed

service.description: Writes parsed iCalendar events (the event maps of the ICalendar tool's parse, see the file comment) into a calendar: a WorkEffort (WetEvent) per UID (universalId) with its WorkEffortRecurrence, and an override instance (one with recurrenceId) as its own WorkEffort linked from its series by WorkEffortAssoc WeatRecurrenceInstance (fromDate the recurrenceId). With replaceAll the calendar's events whose UID is not in the list are cancelled and taken out of it. Each event stands alone: one that fails is logged, counted and left out.

The events of a calendar (view permission; not the cancelled ones) as an iCalendar file, written by the framework's ICalendar tool (write, method PUBLISH) from the event maps of mantle.work.EventServices.get#EventIcsMaps; an error when the tool is turned off.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)

service.description: Reads an iCalendar file into a calendar (edit permission; not a subscription calendar) through the framework's ICalendar tool (parse): new UIDs become events, known ones are updated; an error when the tool is turned off.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)
